name: standing hamstring and calf stretch with strap
description: Standing with a strap around your foot, you pull your toes toward you to stretch the hamstring and calf.
instructions: Stand near a stable support and place one heel slightly in front of you with that knee straight but not locked.
Loop a strap around the ball of the forward foot and hold both ends.
Hinge gently from your hips and draw the toes toward you with the strap until you feel a comfortable stretch in the calf and back of the thigh.
Hold without rounding your back, then switch legs.
